description: Replaced the $O(N^2)$-overhead `get_muon_momentum`, `get_weight_decay`, and `polar_express_coeffs` helper functions (which caused `torch._foreach_copy_` crashes) with direct, inline parameter updates within the `MuonAdamW.__init__` class. This reduced initialization cost from $O(N^2)$ to $O(N)$ while preserving the exact same training logic and val_bpb of 0.9912.
